question.text: An LPG cylinder contains gas at a pressure of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kPa</mi></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>27</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>. The cylinder can withstand the pressure of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>6</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi>Pa</mi></math>. The room in which the cylinder is kept catches fire. The minimum temperature at which the bursting of cylinder will take place is __________ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mo>∘</mo></mmultiscripts></math>. (Nearest integer)
